notes.subject: הדר כבוד הודך
notes.rationale: Tripla tok bilong spanda — hadar, kavod, hod — ol i sanap wantaim; Tok Pisin iwasim ol nem klostu long nois Hibru bilong holim wanem i lus.

notes.subject: אשיחה
notes.rationale: Sapos 'tingting bodi' o 'autim tok' — שיח i min tingting wantaim tok wantaim; KJV 'speak', ASV 'meditate'.

translation: Hadar bilong kavod bilong hod bilong yu, na ol tok bilong ol wondakain wok bilong yu — mi bai tingting bodi na autim ol.
